purpose: Metadata-only reconciliation overlays for the four source-derived Niro draft calculators. Source fixtures remain immutable diagnostic fixtures.

quarantineBoundary.note: The 62-calculator/79-measurement catalog remains quarantined. COVID is an internal nonclinical demonstration fixture and is not a Niro reconciliation draft.

sources.title: Niro Risk Calculators workbook — Diabetes sheet
sources.note: Exact source locator only; this overlay does not approve or alter any clinical boundary.

publishBlockers: [DIA-01,DIA-02,DIA-03] Niro must resolve age 35 and exact HbA1c/FBS endpoint wording; external diagnostic cutoffs cannot overwrite the workbook.
[DIA-04,N3] PP Sugar has labels but no source numeric criteria or approved categorical-input policy.
[DIA-06,DIA-07] Empty glycemic aggregation and missing-waist fallback behavior lack approval.
[DIA-09,DIA-13] Reachable maximum and noninteger-age gap remain unresolved.
[DIA-10,GEN-02] Immutable measurement revision links and claim-level source traceability are incomplete.
[DIA-11,DIA-12,DIA-14,GEN-04,GEN-05] Population, anomalous activity value, and sex-context meaning require source-owner/medical review.
[GEN-06,GEN-07,GEN-08] Complete saved goldens, reviewed content/SEO/citations/authorship, and approved score-lattice semantics are absent.

publicationEligibility.reason: Source-owner, medical-review, content, dependency, and complete-golden gates remain open.

sources.title: Niro Risk Calculators workbook — Heart sheet (trailing-space sheet name)
sources.note: Includes a base-stage 13-points to 10-percent example; it is not a complete final-result example.

publishBlockers: [HRT-01,N6] The single-table sex/unisex applicability question is an absolute publication blocker.
[HRT-02,HRT-03] Applicability below age 30 and numeric treatment of source interval outputs are unresolved.
[HRT-04,HRT-05,HRT-06,N7] Floor value, complete eligibility predicate, and LDL/TC endpoints are unresolved.
[HRT-07,HRT-08,GEN-08] Result-category and triglyceride continuous boundaries require approved lattice/endpoint semantics.
[HRT-09,HRT-10,GEN-03] Missing treatment and glycemic-state behavior could understate risk.
[HRT-11,HRT-12,HRT-13,N8] Probability cap/validity, non-HDL, and vascular-age scope are unresolved.
[HRT-14] Calculator-local 38.61 conversion remains source-specific and must be reviewed, not globally harmonized.
[HRT-16,GEN-06] The 13-to-10 example verifies only a base stage; an approved complete final-input golden is absent (PUB-007 open).
[HRT-17,HRT-18,HRT-20] Missing-value meaning, imputation overlap, and multi-floor clinical approval remain open.
[GEN-02,GEN-04,GEN-05,GEN-07] Measurement snapshots, population/context approval, and reviewed content/evidence are absent.

publicationEligibility.reason: Only a partial base-stage example is source-confirmed; clinical applicability, floor, boundary, content, and dependency gates remain open.

sources.title: Niro Risk Calculators workbook — Hypothyroid sheet
sources.note: The merged symptom rows remain ambiguous and are not resolved by this locator.

publishBlockers: [HYP-01,HYP-05,N5] Niro must decide whether symptom points apply once to the cluster or per symptom row before the maximum/categories are approved.
[HYP-02,HYP-03,GEN-03] Unknown laboratory and omitted Boolean inputs must not silently become normal/false without approval.
[HYP-04] No source-approved minimum-completion or partial-assessment interpretation exists.
[HYP-06,GEN-08] The score lattice or the continuous 15-to-16 seam must be explicitly approved.
[HYP-07,GEN-04] Adult-only population applicability is not established by the workbook.
[GEN-02,GEN-05,GEN-06,GEN-07] Measurement/source traceability, context meaning, complete goldens, and reviewed content/SEO are absent.

publicationEligibility.reason: Symptom, missing-input, partial-assessment, population, content, dependency, and golden gates remain open.

sources.ref: data/sources/risk-analysis/Comprehensive Wellness Score Framework_ A Point-Based Assessment of Health Parameters.pdf#sections-2-6-and-page-18
sources.title: Comprehensive Wellness Score Framework: A Point-Based Assessment of Health Parameters
sources.note: The source itself records rejection because client-stratified ranges were unavailable; this is an absolute publication blocker.

publishBlockers: [CWS-01,N1] Absolute block: the source explicitly rejected this framework because client-stratified ranges were unavailable.
[CWS-03,CWS-04,CWS-19,C5,C7] Partial-input denominator, all-missing-domain, derived-missing, and required/optional behavior lack approval.
[CWS-05,CWS-06,CWS-07,CWS-20,N9] Complete known unbanded regions must remain no-score/blocking until source-owner dispositions exist.
[CWS-08,CWS-09,N2] Afternoon cortisol abnormal bands and conditionally required sampling context are unresolved.
[CWS-10,CWS-11,N4] Estradiol has no two-point/postmenopausal bands and the context selector is incomplete.
[CWS-12,C4,GEN-08] Continuous category seams at 20-to-21, 30-to-31, and 50-to-51 are not clinically approved.
[CWS-13] Declared score extrema do not cover all reachable adjustments and sparse scoring behavior.
[CWS-14,CWS-15] Exact five-year smoking and operational activity boundaries are unresolved.
[CWS-16,GEN-02] eAG derivation provenance must be separated from Niro's scoring decision; claim-level traceability is incomplete.
[CWS-18] Unit-alias decisions remain incomplete and require reviewed stable measurement/unit identities.
[GEN-04,GEN-05,GEN-06,GEN-07] Population/context approval, complete goldens, and reviewed content/SEO/citations/authorship are absent.

publicationEligibility.reason: CWS must stay draft pending Niro stratified-range confirmation; build work cannot overrule the source rejection.
